verdict.rationale: Bruno states it is not training AI models on user data, and it is offline-only with no cloud sync, account, or login. Its AI features use Bring Your Own Key with no data routed through Bruno servers, and they can point at local models such as Ollama, so user data never reaches the vendor and can stay off third-party AI services entirely. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-training claim, and a formal privacy-policy or contractual commitment on training (beyond homepage marketing copy).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models

citations.quote: No cloud sync. No account. No login. We have zero visibility into your requests, and we're not training AI models on your data.
Bruno is offline-only. There are no plans to add cloud-sync to Bruno, ever.
Bruno AI uses a Bring Your Own Key model. You connect your own provider account and Bruno uses it directly. No data is routed through Bruno servers.
self-hosted inference servers, and local model applications such as Ollama or LM Studio
License Administrators can govern Bruno AI across the organization, controlling which providers and models are allowed and how requests are protected.
